verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂא֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ אֶת־ קוֹלָ֑ם וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiś·śā kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū hā·‘ām bal·lay·lāh ha·hū
verses.literal: Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out and that night the people wept
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO toda a congregação levantou a sua voz; e o povo chorou naquela noite.

verses.original: וַיִּלֹּ֙נוּ֙ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֗ה לוּ־ מַ֙תְנוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם א֛וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה לוּ־ מָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·lō·nū ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn kōl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lū- maṯ·nū bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ’ōw bam·miḏ·bār haz·zeh lū- mā·ṯə·nū
verses.literal: All the Israelites . . . grumbled against Moses . . . and Aaron and the whole congregation said to them If only we had died in the land of Egypt or if only we had died in this wilderness
verses.literalPt: E todos os filhos de Israel murmuraram contra Moisés e contra Arão; e toda a congregação lhes disse: Quem dera tivéssemos morrido na terra do Egito! ou, mesmo neste deserto!

verses.original: וְלָמָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה מֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜נוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לִנְפֹּ֣ל בַּחֶ֔רֶב נָשֵׁ֥ינוּ וְטַפֵּ֖נוּ יִהְי֣וּ לָבַ֑ז הֲל֧וֹא ט֦וֹב לָ֖נוּ שׁ֥וּב מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·māh Yah·weh mê·ḇî ’ō·ṯā·nū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lin·pōl ba·ḥe·reḇ nā·šê·nū wə·ṭap·pê·nū yih·yū lā·ḇaz hă·lō·w ṭō·wḇ lā·nū šūḇ miṣ·rā·yə·māh
verses.literal: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword Our wives and children will become plunder Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt
verses.literalPt: E por que o SENHOR nos traz a esta terra, para cairmos à espada, e para que nossas mulheres e nossas crianças sejam por presa? Não nos seria melhor voltarmos ao Egito?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו נִתְּנָ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw nit·tə·nāh rōš wə·nā·šū·ḇāh miṣ·rā·yə·māh
verses.literal: So they said to one another Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt
verses.literalPt: E diziam uns aos outros: Constituamos um líder, e voltemos ao Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם לִפְנֵ֕י כָּל־ קְהַ֥ל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pōl mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ‘al- pə·nê·hem lip̄·nê kāl- qə·hal ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole assembly of the congregation . . . of Israel
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés e Arão caíram sobre os seus rostos perante toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן וְכָלֵב֙ בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֔ה מִן־ הַתָּרִ֖ים אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ קָרְע֖וּ בִּגְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh min- hat·tā·rîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ qā·rə·‘ū biḡ·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh who were among those who had spied out the land tore their clothes
verses.literalPt: E Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, dos que espiaram a terra, rasgaram as suas vestes.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֤רְנוּ בָהּ֙ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֔הּ טוֹבָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇar·nū ḇāh lā·ṯūr ’ō·ṯāh ṭō·w·ḇāh hā·’ā·reṣ mə·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and said to the whole congregation . . . of Israel . . . The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly . . . good land
verses.literalPt: E falaram a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A terra pela qual passamos a espiar é terra muito boa.

verses.original: אִם־ חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֙נוּ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵבִ֤יא אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָ֑נוּ אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֛וא זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·p̄êṣ bā·nū Yah·weh wə·hê·ḇî ’ō·ṯā·nū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ū·nə·ṯā·nāh lā·nū ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer- hî zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: If the LORD delights in us He will bring us into this land a land - flowing with milk and honey and He will give it to us
verses.literalPt: Se o SENHOR se agradar de nós, então nos porá nesta terra, e no-la dará; terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּֽיהוָה֮ אַל־ תִּמְרֹדוּ֒ וְאַתֶּ֗ם אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ אֶת־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י לַחְמֵ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם סָ֣ר צִלָּ֧ם מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֛ם וַֽיהוָ֥ה אִתָּ֖נוּ אַל־ תִּירָאֻֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ Yah·weh ’al- tim·rō·ḏū wə·’at·tem ’al- tî·rə·’ū ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ kî laḥ·mê·nū hêm sār ṣil·lām mê·‘ă·lê·hem Yah·weh ’it·tā·nū ’al- tî·rā·’um
verses.literal: Only do not rebel . . . against the LORD and do not be afraid of the people of the land for they will be like bread for us . . . Their protection has been removed . . . and the LORD is with us Do not be afraid of them
verses.literalPt: Tão-somente não sejais rebeldes contra o SENHOR, e não temais o povo dessa terra, porquanto são eles nosso pão; retirou-se deles o seu amparo, e o SENHOR é conosco; não os temais.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִרְגּ֥וֹם אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֗ה נִרְאָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lir·gō·wm ’ō·ṯām bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh nir·’āh bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the Israelites . . . at the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Mas toda a congregação disse que os apedrejassem; porém a glória do SENHOR apareceu na tenda da congregação a todos os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־ אָ֥נָה יְנַאֲצֻ֖נִי הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַד־ אָ֙נָה֙ לֹא־ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ בִ֔י בְּכֹל֙ הָֽאֹת֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh yə·na·’ă·ṣu·nî hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh lō- ya·’ă·mî·nū ḇî bə·ḵōl hā·’ō·ṯō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses How long . . . will this people treat Me with contempt How long . . . will they refuse to believe in Me despite all the signs I have performed among them
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Até quando me provocará este povo? e até quando não crerá em mim, apesar de todos os sinais que fiz no meio dele?

verses.original: אַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַדֶּ֖בֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־ גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ak·ken·nū ḇad·de·ḇer wə·’ō·w·ri·šen·nū wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā lə·ḡō·w- gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘ā·ṣūm mim·men·nū
verses.literal: I will strike them with a plague and destroy them and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are
verses.literalPt: Com pestilência o ferirei, e o rejeitarei; e te farei a ti povo maior e mais forte do que este.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּֽי־ הֶעֱלִ֧יתָ בְכֹחֲךָ֛ אֶת־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִקִּרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh wə·šā·mə·‘ū miṣ·ra·yim kî- he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā ḇə·ḵō·ḥă·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh miq·qir·bōw
verses.literal: But Moses said to the LORD The Egyptians will hear of it for by Your strength You brought this people from among them
verses.literalPt: E disse Moisés ao SENHOR: Assim os egípcios o ouvirão; porquanto com a tua força fizeste subir este povo do meio deles.

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ אֶל־ יוֹשֵׁב֮ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּאת֒ שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּקֶ֖רֶב הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ עַ֨יִן בְּעַ֜יִן נִרְאָ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲנָֽנְךָ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עֲלֵהֶ֔ם וּבְעַמֻּ֣ד עָנָ֗ן אַתָּ֨ה הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבְעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ’el- yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ šā·mə·‘ū kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh bə·qe·reḇ hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer- ‘a·yin bə·‘a·yin nir·’āh ’at·tāh Yah·weh wa·‘ă·nā·nə·ḵā ‘ō·mêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem ū·ḇə·‘am·muḏ ‘ā·nān ’at·tāh hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·hem yō·w·mām ū·ḇə·‘am·mūḏ ’êš lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land They have already heard that You O LORD are in the midst of this people that You O LORD have been seen face to face that Your cloud stands over them and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night
verses.literalPt: E dirão aos moradores desta terra, os quais ouviram que tu, ó SENHOR, estás no meio deste povo, que face a face, ó SENHOR, lhes apareces, que tua nuvem está sobre ele e que vais adiante dele numa coluna de nuvem de dia, e numa coluna de fogo de noite.

verses.original: וְהֵמַתָּ֛ה אֶת־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶֽת־ שִׁמְעֲךָ֖ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·mat·tāh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh kə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’ā·mə·rū hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- šā·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- šim·‘ă·ḵā lê·mōr
verses.literal: If You kill this people as one man the nations who have heard of Your fame . . . will say
verses.literalPt: E se matares este povo como a um só homem, então as nações, que antes ouviram a tua fama, falarão, dizendo:

verses.original: מִבִּלְתִּ֞י יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֗ה לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bil·tî yə·ḵō·leṯ Yah·weh lə·hā·ḇî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘ lā·hem way·yiš·ḥā·ṭêm bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them He has slaughtered them in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Porquanto o SENHOR não podia pôr este povo na terra que lhe tinha jurado; por isso os matou no deserto.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יִגְדַּל־ נָ֖א כֹּ֣חַ אֲדֹנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yiḡ·dal- nā kō·aḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā lê·mōr
verses.literal: So now I pray may the power of my Lord be magnified just as You have declared . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, rogo-te que a força do meu Senhor se engrandeça; como tens falado, dizendo:

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־ חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָפָ֑שַׁע וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל־ בָּנִ֔ים עַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ nō·śê ‘ā·wōn wā·p̄ā·ša‘ wə·naq·qêh lō yə·naq·qeh pō·qêḏ ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm ‘al- šil·lê·šîm wə·‘al- rib·bê·‘îm
verses.literal: The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion forgiving iniquity and transgression Yet He will by no means . . . leave the guilty unpunished He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third . . . and fourth generation
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é longânimo, e grande em misericórdia, que perdoa a iniqüidade e a transgressão, que o culpado não tem por inocente, e visita a iniqüidade dos pais sobre os filhos até à terceira e quarta geração.

verses.original: סְלַֽח־ נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: sə·laḥ- nā la·‘ă·wōn hā·‘ām haz·zeh kə·ḡō·ḏel ḥas·de·ḵā wə·ḵa·’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯāh lā·‘ām haz·zeh mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ- hên·nāh
verses.literal: Pardon I pray the iniquity of this people in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion just as You have forgiven them . . . ever since they left Egypt
verses.literalPt: Perdoa, pois, a iniqüidade deste povo, segundo a grandeza da tua misericórdia; e como também perdoaste a este povo desde a terra do Egito até aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh sā·laḥ·tî kiḏ·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: I have pardoned them as you requested the LORD replied
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR: Conforme à tua palavra lhe perdoei.

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֖ם חַי־ אָ֑נִי וְיִמָּלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām ḥay- ’ā·nî wə·yim·mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Yet as surely as I live and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém, tão certamente como eu vivo, e como a glória do SENHOR encherá toda a terra,

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָרֹאִ֤ים אֶת־ כְּבֹדִי֙ וְאֶת־ אֹ֣תֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי בְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּבַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֹתִ֗י זֶ֚ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·rō·’îm ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·ḏî wə·’eṯ- ’ō·ṯō·ṯay ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇam·miḏ·bār way·nas·sū ’ō·ṯî zeh ‘e·śer pə·‘ā·mîm wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū bə·qō·w·lî
verses.literal: not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times
verses.literalPt: E que todos os homens que viram a minha glória e os meus sinais, que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e me tentaram estas dez vezes, e não obedeceram à minha voz,

verses.original: אִם־ יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֑ם וְכָל־ מְנַאֲצַ֖י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yir·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯām wə·ḵāl mə·na·’ă·ṣay lō yir·’ū·hā
verses.literal: not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers None . . . of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it
verses.literalPt: Não verão a terra de que a seus pais jurei, e nenhum daqueles que me provocaram a verá.

verses.original: וְעַבְדִּ֣י כָלֵ֗ב עֵ֣קֶב הָֽיְתָ֞ה ר֤וּחַ אַחֶ֙רֶת֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיְמַלֵּ֖א אַחֲרָ֑י וַהֲבִֽיאֹתִ֗יו אֶל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣א שָׁ֔מָּה וְזַרְע֖וֹ יוֹרִשֶֽׁנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḇ·dî ḵā·lêḇ ‘ê·qeḇ hā·yə·ṯāh rū·aḥ ’a·ḥe·reṯ ‘im·mōw way·mal·lê ’a·ḥă·rāy wa·hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯîw ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- bā šām·māh wə·zar·‘ōw yō·w·ri·šen·nāh
verses.literal: But because My servant Caleb has . . . a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly I will bring him into the land he has entered . . . and his descendants will inherit it
verses.literalPt: Porém o meu servo Calebe, porquanto nele houve outro espírito, e perseverou em seguir-me, eu o levarei à terra em que entrou, e a sua descendência a possuirá em herança.

verses.original: וְהָֽעֲמָלֵקִ֥י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּעֵ֑מֶק מָחָ֗ר פְּנ֨וּ וּסְע֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־ סֽוּף׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî yō·wō·šêḇ bā·‘ê·meq mā·ḥār pə·nū ū·sə·‘ū lā·ḵem ham·miḏ·bār de·reḵ yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: Now since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys turn back tomorrow and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Ora, os amalequitas e os cananeus habitam no vale; tornai-vos amanhã e caminhai para o deserto pelo caminho do Mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֗י לָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה מַלִּינִ֖ים עָלָ֑י אֶת־ תְּלֻנּ֞וֹת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧מָּה מַלִּינִ֛ים עָלַ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay lā·‘ê·ḏāh hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer hêm·māh mal·lî·nîm ‘ā·lāy ’eṯ- tə·lun·nō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer hêm·māh mal·lî·nîm ‘ā·lay šā·mā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: How long . . . will this wicked congregation grumble against Me I have heard the complaints that the Israelites . . . . . . . . . are making against Me
verses.literalPt: Até quando sofrerei esta má congregação, que murmura contra mim? Tenho ouvido as murmurações dos filhos de Israel, com que murmuram contra mim.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם חַי־ אָ֙נִי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ לֹ֕א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם בְּאָזְנָ֑י כֵּ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im- lō ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tem bə·’ā·zə·nāy kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: So tell them . . . As surely as I live declares the LORD I will do to you exactly . . . as I heard . . . you say
verses.literalPt: Dize-lhes: Vivo eu, diz o SENHOR, que, como falastes aos meus ouvidos, assim farei a vós outros.

verses.original: בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה יִפְּל֨וּ פִגְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְכָל־ פְּקֻדֵיכֶם֙ לְכָל־ מִסְפַּרְכֶ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲלִֽינֹתֶ֖ם עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bam·miḏ·bār haz·zeh yip·pə·lū p̄iḡ·rê·ḵem wə·ḵāl pə·qu·ḏê·ḵem lə·ḵāl mis·par·ḵem mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wā·mā·‘ə·lāh ’ă·šer hă·lî·nō·ṯem ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness all who were numbered in the census everyone twenty years of age . . . or older because you have grumbled against Me
verses.literalPt: Neste deserto cairão os vossos cadáveres, como também todos os que de vós foram contados segundo toda a vossa conta, de vinte anos para cima, os que dentre vós contra mim murmurastes;

verses.original: אִם־ אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּ֑הּ כִּ֚י אִם־ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’at·tem tā·ḇō·’ū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lə·šak·kên ’eṯ·ḵem bāh kî ’im- kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn
verses.literal: Surely none of you will enter . . . the land in which I swore to settle you except . . . Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun
verses.literalPt: Não entrareis na terra, pela qual levantei a minha mão que vos faria habitar nela, salvo Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.

verses.original: וְטַ֨פְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭap·pə·ḵem ’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem lā·ḇaz yih·yeh wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’ō·ṯām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer mə·’as·tem bāh
verses.literal: But I will bring your children whom you said would become plunder into the land you have rejected and they will enjoy it
verses.literalPt: Mas os vossos filhos, de que dizeis: Por presa serão, porei nela; e eles conhecerão a terra que vós desprezastes.

verses.original: וּפִגְרֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֑ם יִפְּל֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄iḡ·rê·ḵem ’at·tem yip·pə·lū bam·miḏ·bār haz·zeh
verses.literal: As for you however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness
verses.literalPt: Porém, quanto a vós, os vossos cadáveres cairão neste deserto.

verses.original: וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם יִהְי֨וּ רֹעִ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ זְנוּתֵיכֶ֑ם עַד־ תֹּ֥ם פִּגְרֵיכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem yih·yū rō·‘îm bam·miḏ·bār ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh wə·nā·śə·’ū ’eṯ- zə·nū·ṯê·ḵem ‘aḏ- tōm piḡ·rê·ḵem bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Your children will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years and they will suffer for your unfaithfulness until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E vossos filhos pastorearão neste deserto quarenta anos, e levarão sobre si as vossas infidelidades, até que os vossos cadáveres se consumam neste deserto.

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּ֨ר הַיָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ תַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָרֶץ֮ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יוֹם֒ י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֞ה י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֗ה תִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ תְּנוּאָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mis·par hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- tar·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm yō·wm laš·šā·nāh yō·wm laš·šā·nāh tiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh wî·ḏa‘·tem ’eṯ- tə·nū·’ā·ṯî
verses.literal: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land you shall bear your guilt forty years a year for each day - and you will experience My alienation
verses.literalPt: Segundo o número dos dias em que espiastes esta terra, quarenta dias, cada dia representando um ano, levareis sobre vós as vossas iniqüidades quarenta anos, e conhecereis o meu afastamento.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ דִּבַּרְתִּי֒ אִם־ לֹ֣א׀ זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֗ה לְכָל־ הָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את הַנּוֹעָדִ֖ים עָלָ֑י בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה יִתַּ֖מּוּ וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî ’im- lō zōṯ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ han·nō·w·‘ā·ḏîm ‘ā·lāy bam·miḏ·bār haz·zeh yit·tam·mū wə·šām yā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: I the LORD have spoken and I will surely . . . do these things to this entire wicked . . . congregation which has conspired against Me They will meet their end in the wilderness . . . and there they will die
verses.literalPt: Eu, o SENHOR, falei; assim farei a toda esta má congregação, que se levantou contra mim; neste deserto se consumirão, e aí falecerão. 36 E os homens que Moisés mandara a espiar a terra, e que, voltando, fizeram murmurar toda a congregação contra ele, infamando a terra,

verses.original: וְהָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּשֻׁ֗בוּ וַיִּלּוֹנוּ עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לְהוֹצִ֥יא דִבָּ֖ה עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ mō·šeh lā·ṯūr ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yil·lō·nū ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lə·hō·w·ṣî ḏib·bāh ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So the men Moses had sent to spy out the land who had returned and made the whole congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: וַיָּמֻ֙תוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים מוֹצִאֵ֥י דִבַּת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ רָעָ֑ה בַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·mu·ṯū hā·’ă·nā·šîm mō·w·ṣi·’ê ḏib·baṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ rā·‘āh bam·mag·gê·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: those men who had brought out the bad report about the land were struck down by a plague before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Aqueles mesmos homens que infamaram a terra, morreram de praga perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן וְכָלֵ֖ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֑ה חָיוּ֙ מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הַֽהֹלְכִ֖ים לָת֥וּר אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh ḥā·yū min- hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·hêm ha·hō·lə·ḵîm lā·ṯūr ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive
verses.literalPt: Mas Josué, filho de Num, e Calebe, filho de Jefoné, que eram dos homens que foram espiar a terra, ficaram com vida.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiṯ·’ab·bə·lū hā·‘ām mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: And when Moses relayed these words to all the Israelites . . . the people mourned bitterly
verses.literalPt: E falou Moisés estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel; então o povo se contristou muito.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּֽעֲל֥וּ אֶל־ רֹאשׁ־ הָהָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֶּ֗נּוּ וְעָלִ֛ינוּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ki·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·ya·‘ă·lū ’el- rōš- hā·hār lê·mōr hin·nen·nū wə·‘ā·lî·nū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- ’ā·mar Yah·weh kî ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: Early the next morning they got up and went up toward the ridge of the hill country We have indeed sinned they said but we will go to the place the LORD has promised
verses.literalPt: E levantaram-se pela manhã de madrugada, e subiram ao cume do monte, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui, e subiremos ao lugar que o SENHOR tem falado; porquanto havemos pecado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֛ה אַתֶּ֥ם עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א תִצְלָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lām·māh zeh ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh wə·hi·w lō ṯiṣ·lāḥ
verses.literal: But Moses said Why . . . are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD This will not succeed
verses.literalPt: Mas Moisés disse: Por que transgredis o mandado do SENHOR? Pois isso não prosperará.

verses.original: אַֽל־ תַּעֲל֔וּ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין יְהוָ֖ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·‘ă·lū kî ’ên Yah·weh bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·lō tin·nā·ḡə·p̄ū lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not go up lest you be struck down by your enemies because the LORD is not among you
verses.literalPt: Não subais, pois o SENHOR não estará no meio de vós, para que não sejais feridos diante dos vossos inimigos.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָעֲמָלֵקִ֨י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֤ן שַׁבְתֶּם֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî šām lip̄·nê·ḵem ū·nə·p̄al·tem be·ḥā·reḇ kî- ‘al- kên šaḇ·tem mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh wə·lō- yih·yeh Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: For there the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you and you will fall by the sword Because . . . . . . you have turned away from the LORD He will not be with you
verses.literalPt: Porque os amalequitas e os cananeus estão ali diante da vossa face, e caireis à espada; pois, porquanto vos desviastes do SENHOR, o SENHOR não estará convosco.

verses.original: וַיַּעְפִּ֕לוּ לַעֲל֖וֹת אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַאֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ וּמֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא־ מָ֖שׁוּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·pi·lū la·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’el- rōš hā·hār wa·’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ū·mō·šeh lō- mā·šū miq·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: But they dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country though neither Moses nor the ark of the covenant of the LORD moved from the camp
verses.literalPt: Contudo, temerariamente, tentaram subir ao cume do monte; mas a arca da aliança do SENHOR e Moisés não se apartaram do meio do arraial.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּהָ֣ר הַה֑וּא וַיַּכּ֥וּם וַֽיַּכְּת֖וּם עַד־ הַֽחָרְמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·šêḇ bā·hār ha·hū way·yak·kūm way·yak·kə·ṯūm ‘aḏ- ha·ḥā·rə·māh
verses.literal: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that part of the hill country came down attacked them and routed them all the way to Hormah
verses.literalPt: Então desceram os amalequitas e os cananeus, que habitavam na montanha, e os feriram, derrotando-os até Horma.
